subject: Voucher sunset reconciliation & invoice netting plan (Storly AI / DEAL-4821)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@storly.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@storly.ai
Date: 2028-07-22 09:12 PDT
Subject: Request: apply remaining voucher and short extension for POC (DEAL-4821)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the run last month — the team hit a few unexpected throughput spikes during the POC and we were pinged for overages. We still have an unused promotional voucher balance from the original POC grant and would like to confirm two asks:

1) Can Redwood apply the remaining voucher balance as a credit memo against Invoice 2028-07-03 so it nets the overage? We estimate the remaining voucher at $8,000 (attached CSV shows usage + original stipend).
2) We need one-week trial/POC extension through July 30 to finish performance tests while the credit settles.

If you need a formal POA or paperwork, happy to loop procurement. Attaching a quick usage export and the voucher reference.

Best,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of ML Ops, Storly AI
attachments: pilot_usage_export_2028-07.csv (csv), voucher_ref_4821.txt (text)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@storly.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-22 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: apply remaining voucher and short extension for POC (DEAL-4821)

Daniel — thanks for the note and the CSV. We can definitely do an invoice offset instead of issuing a standalone refund in this case. Two quick items I need to confirm with finance before I sign off:

- Exact credit memo amount to post (do you confirm $8,000 available to apply?).
- Should the credit be applied fully to Invoice 2028-07-03 (overage + subscription) or partial with remaining held as a voucher?
- Extension: we can grant a one-week extension on the same terms; I’ll coordinate the service toggle once accounting confirms the offset.

Looping Laura + Karthik for accounting/ops: Laura — can you confirm preferred routing for a promotional voucher conversion here (credit memo vs contra-revenue write-off)? Karthik — if accounting is good, can you handle the entitlement toggle and DocuSign addendum if needed?

Thanks,
Marcus
Sr. Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments: credit_memo_DEAL-4821.pdf (stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-23 08:35 PDT
Subject: RE: Request: apply remaining voucher and short extension for POC (DEAL-4821)

Folks — reviewed usage export and voucher history. Summary + proposed accounting treatment: 

- Voucher balance available: $8,125.54 (unapplied promotional allowance tied to POC).
- Overages on Invoice 2028-07-03: $2,143.20. Normal approach: apply credit memo to invoice to net the receivable. Remaining balance can be posted to a contra-revenue allowance account (G/L: 4102-PRM-A) as a promotional settlement if customer requests it held as a voucher.

Recommendation (cleanest for AR): issue a credit memo for $8,125.54 and apply it against Invoice 2028-07-03. This will create a net credit on the customer's account; any true remaining balance after invoice netting should be documented on the credit memo and left as an unapplied credit (not a cash refund). That avoids an AR write-off and preserves audit trail.

If Storly prefers a partial application (only net overage), we can apply $2,143.20 and leave $5,982.34 as an unapplied credit. For month-end close I’ll need:
- Approval to post CM for full $8,125.54 OR
- Confirmation to post CM $2,143.20 and retain remainder as unapplied promo credit.

Also: to support revenue recognition, please confirm whether the original promo was recorded as a marketing allowance or a deferred credit — I’ll check the original journal but would like your confirmation.

–Laura
Manager, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: NA

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Laura / Marcus — quick ops checklist from my side if we proceed:

- If CM = full $8,125.54: I will route to Billing for CM posting and mark Invoice 2028-07-03 as fully offset, then update entitlement to extend POC through 2028-07-30. No DocuSign required.
- If CM = just overage $2,143.20: I will post partial CM, leave unapplied credit on account, and create a one-week temporary entitlement token tied to DEAL-4821; customer must sign the extension addendum only if any pricing changes occur.

Action items requested from Storly: confirm which option they want and signoff on leaving unapplied balance (if any).

Karthik
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

If you need any additional paperwork, we’ll accept the credit memo as sufficient. Karthik — please toggle the entitlement. Laura — confirm when CM posts so we can reconcile on our side.

Regards,
Daniel
